facts.value: Passes the reflected Green Shell to it_80273030, then copies Item.xD48_halfLifeTimer into ItemVars.gshell.xDD4. The grounded active animation callback tests this countdown before decrementing and returns true when it is non-positive; the airborne active callback only decrements positive values and always returns false. Generic item animation dispatch removes the item on a true animation result, while common lifetime processing is a separate removal path.

facts.value: Performs collision maintenance for stationary Green Shell state 0: it supplies the state-1 entry helper it_8028C018 to common ground-collision processing, updates rolling-shell model rotation if the resulting item is grounded, and returns false. It is not the collision callback of the initial spawned state, which is state 1.

After that processing, it updates rolling-shell rotation only if ground_or_air is GA_Ground, then returns false regardless of any delegated state change.

facts.value: Enters the Green Shell's special state 9, which participates in terrain-dependent motion rather than simply representing ordinary off-platform falling. The low-speed landing dispatcher selects it when it_80277040's surface-tangential-motion processing returns true. State 9's collision processing can retain terrain interaction, settle into state 0 under its guards, or enter falling state 1 when no floor is detected.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes the shared active-air states 7/8 from initial/rebound falling state 1. The rendered baseline names otherwise differ only in capitalization. This is a semantic name proposal, not recovered original spelling.
Corrects the unsupported support-test interpretation while retaining the visible settling and active-motion roles.
facts.value: Implements the Green Shell's speed-dependent landing response. A shell at or above the horizontal-speed threshold enters active grounded initialization. A slower shell has its ordinary velocity cleared, then either settles into stationary state 0 or enters special terrain-motion state 9 according to shared surface-tangential-motion processing. The 0/9 decision is not simply whether the shell has left the terrain.

facts.rationale: Makes the central landing dispatcher explanation fit the independently inspected callee rather than the rendered EnteredAir name.
facts.value: Refreshes the Green Shell's environmental collision bounds and selects its post-contact movement setup. At or above attribute x8 horizontal speed it invokes grounded active initialization; below x8 it clears all ordinary velocity and calls it_80277040, entering stationary state 0 on false or special state 9 on true. That shared helper processes surface-normal-derived tangential motion, not a simple floor-support test.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exact strict threshold and numeric destinations while documenting the important exceptional shared-helper branches.
facts.value: After refreshing the ECB, tests ABS(x40_vel.x) < attrs->x8. If false, invokes it_8028C3A8, which clamps speed and selects state 5 or 6. If true, clears x/y/z velocity and invokes it_80277040: false selects stationary state 0 through it_8028BE54, while true selects state 9 through EnteredAir. The helper's false paths include negligible ItemAttr.x50, insufficient surface angle, and an exhausted direction-change counter; its result must not be interpreted as floor absence.

evidence.why: Frame reset, animation handling and callback clearing.

facts.rationale: Corrects the animation-preservation claim and records the cross-file callback/effect lifetime that explains why installation follows the state change.
facts.value: Initializes active airborne Green Shell behavior by resetting shared state and timers, clamping horizontal speed, and selecting state 8 when the resulting speed is below attrs->x8 or state 7 otherwise; the state-8 path also calls it_8026B390. Both calls request ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE, not animation-progress preservation. Generic state changing resets the current animation frame, updates or removes animation according to the selected row, flushes queued effects, installs callbacks, and clears jumped_on; this initializer subsequently restores the shell's jumped_on callback.
